method.tsne: sklearn TSNE barnes_hut, perplexity=30, max_iter=1000, init=pca, random_state=42
method.kmeans: sklearn KMeans k=8 (STATED, not eyeballed), n_init=10, random_state=42, fit on 64-d embeddings

meta.coord_encoding: int millis: coordinate / 1000 = value at 3-decimal precision (identical precision to round(x, 3), fewer bytes than float text)
meta.id: omitted per-point; point id IS its index in the points array

fields.s: season starting year as int; 1996 = the 1996-97 season
fields.pca/tsne/umap: 3 coords as int millis; divide by 1000 (3-decimal-equivalent precision)
